title.narrative: Preventing Gender-Based Violence Through Education and Awareness Raising

description.narrative:
The action aims to promote the implementation of effective measures for preventing and combating violence against women at the national and local level.

It aims to raise awareness of the problems and extent of GBV and its serious consequences for society as a whole. Different stakeholders are addressed and many actors such as the media and educational institutions are involved.
